_comment: Study and practice sources. Each entry says which sheet, which tab, how to
read it, and when the picked items are due. Override the whole file with the
STUDY_SOURCES_PATH env var, or a JSON list in STUDY_SOURCES.
backlog — a flat list of topics/questions/projects. Each sync picks the
next `daily_count` rows you have not been given yet.
weekly  — one row per week, keyed by a date column. Picks the row for the
current week and emits `item_columns` from it.
due_time is local (24h). Items land in the block of your day where that kind
of work actually happens, per your Daily-Schedule-Template.

_comment: Themes are picked per day so no area quietly eats the week.
'daily' runs every day. One entry from 'cycle' runs alongside it,
advancing by date so the cycle is stable across restarts and you can
see what tomorrow holds. Tasks are filed proposed, like everything else.
'sources' names study_sources keys to run only on that theme's day.
remind=false means tracked and shown on /day but never a reminder.

daily.label: Web3 bounty
tasks: Work one bounty target for 45 minutes — scope, then one contract
Read one Solodit audit report and note the bug class

variants.name: EVM
tasks: RareSkills: one chapter, notes written as you go — https://rareskills.io/learn-solidity
Read one opcode's semantics on evm.codes and explain gas cost aloud — https://www.evm.codes/

variants.name: Solana
tasks: One Solana Cookbook recipe, typed out not copied — https://solanacookbook.com/
Read one program-examples repo end to end — https://github.com/solana-developers/program-examples

variants.name: Cosmos
tasks: One Cosmos SDK tutorial module, built locally — https://tutorials.cosmos.network/
Explain IBC packet flow from memory, then check — https://ibc.cosmos.network/

variants.name: Infra
tasks: One Alchemy docs topic: RPC methods, webhooks or indexing — https://docs.alchemy.com/
Alchemy University: one lesson, exercises done — https://www.alchemy.com/university

cycle.label: Web2 / systems
tasks: One system-design narration, 35 minutes, out loud

cycle.label: Football
tasks: Move this week's BUILD forward by one concrete step

cycle.label: Video
tasks: Record one short: a thing you learned this week, 90 seconds

cycle.label: Writing
tasks: Draft or ship one article section — no new outlines

cycle.label: Code review
tasks: Review one open PR or reread one of your own modules critically

cycle.label: Interview prep
tasks: Two DSA problems, timed, narrated out loud
Three STAR stories aloud from the bank

cycle.label: Job applications
tasks: Send two applications with a tailored first line
Follow up on anything sent more than a week ago

variants.name: EVM
tasks: Answer aloud: storage vs memory vs calldata, delegatecall risks, proxy storage collisions
One Ethernaut level, then write why it broke — https://ethernaut.openzeppelin.com/

variants.name: Solana
tasks: Answer aloud: accounts model vs EVM, PDAs, rent, CPI, compute budget
Anchor: explain a program's account constraints line by line — https://www.anchor-lang.com/

variants.name: Cosmos
tasks: Answer aloud: ABCI, modules, keepers, IBC light clients, validator set changes
Read one Cosmos SDK module's keeper and narrate it — https://docs.cosmos.network/

variants.name: Security
tasks: One Damn Vulnerable DeFi challenge, write the exploit up — https://www.damnvulnerabledefi.xyz/
One Solodit finding: restate the bug class in your own words — https://solodit.cyfrin.io/
